name: Air temperature display limit (models not equipped with Navigation System)
value: The display will remain and blink ‘‘122°F (50°C)’’
quote: Above 122°F (50°C) The display will remain and blink ''122°F (50°C)'' (Models not equipped with Navigation System)

name: Service more frequently in unusually wet or dusty areas
quote: Service more frequently if the motorcycle is ridden in unusually wet or dusty areas.

name: Service frequency
quote: Service more frequently if the motorcycle is ridden often at full throttle or in the rain.

name: Engine oil change interval in dusty conditions
quote: When running in very dusty conditions, oil changes should be performed more frequently than specified in the maintenance schedule.

name: Crankcase breather service in wet conditions
value: ridden in the rain or often at full throttle
quote: Service the crankcase breather more frequently if your motorcycle is ridden in the rain or often at full throttle.

name: Battery storage environment
value: protected from freezing temperatures and direct sunlight
quote: Store your battery in an easy-to-reach location off the floor, in an area protected from freezing temperatures and direct sunlight.

name: salt_wash
quote: Aluminum may corrode from contact with dirt, mud, or road salt. Clean the wheels after riding through any of these substances.

name: Battery storage temperature
quote: Store it in an area protected from freezing temperatures and direct sunlight.
